verdict.rationale: Gitea's own repository says it ships an official CLI tool called tea, and a probe confirms its documentation at gitea.com/gitea/tea. That directly satisfies the story's core requirement of an official CLI. However, the pack gives no detail on the CLI's commands, scripting or machine-readable output, or AI-agent workflow use. missing for 10: documented CLI command coverage and non-interactive/JSON output for agent workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration of tea in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: We provide an official go-sdk, a CLI tool called tea and an action runner for Gitea Action.
